Stockfish.js 19.0.1 lite single-threaded browser build

The engine files stockfish.js and stockfish.wasm are unmodified binary assets
from the stockfish 19.0.1 npm package, maintained by Nathan Rugg and contributors.
They are separate from the jukebox's original code and licensed under GPL-3.0.
The license is included in COPYING.txt. Engine source and build instructions:
https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js/tree/v19.0.1
Source archive: https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js/archive/refs/tags/v19.0.1.tar.gz
Package distribution: https://www.npmjs.com/package/stockfish/v/19.0.1
Stockfish project: https://stockfishchess.org/
